✦ Before you come in
Your insurance card
We check your benefits before you arrive, so what is covered — and what is not — is settled between us before anything is started.
Any treatment plan you were given elsewhere
Bring it with you. A second opinion here is free, and it is the quickest way to know whether the plan you were handed is the one you actually need.
The questions you have not asked yet
Write them down while they are fresh. Nothing is started at your visit without your say-so, so the more you ask now, the less there is to decide in the chair.
No cost, no obligation.
We walk you through everything on the call. There is no pressure to decide.

Why Mason Park Dental?
Experience
Dr. Cho obtained his dental degree from Tufts University, and Dr. Sung holds a Fellowship in the Academy of General Dentistry, held by only 7% of general dentists in Texas.
Personalized Care

Dr. Sung, Dr. Cho and Dr. Nguyen are committed to providing excellent dentistry in a comfortable environment, and we welcome new patients of all ages. Dr. Cho is experienced in oral sedation for patients who need it.
Clear Costs

You leave knowing exactly where your teeth stand, and exactly what anything further would cost, before a single thing is started. We are an insurance-friendly office and our team verifies your benefits before you commit to treatment.
before you call
Any Questions Before You Call?
How long does Invisalign® treatment take?
Treatment length varies based on individual needs. Some patients see results in a few months, while others require longer treatment.
Is Invisalign® painful?
Some mild pressure may occur when switching aligners, but discomfort is temporary and minimal.
Who is a good candidate?
Teens and adults with mild to moderate spacing, crowding, or bite concerns are typically good candidates.
Can I eat and drink with Invisalign®?
Aligners should be removed before eating or drinking anything other than water, allowing you to enjoy your favorite foods.
Does dental insurance cover Invisalign®?
Many dental insurance plans include benefits that apply to Invisalign® treatment. Our team can help verify your coverage.
Will I know my treatment cost before starting?
Yes. A detailed treatment plan and cost breakdown are provided before treatment begins, and we offer flexible financing options to help make Invisalign® treatment accessible.
Will I need a retainer afterwards?
Yes. Retainers are essential to maintain your results and prevent teeth from shifting. A set of Vivera® retainers is included in your treatment.
